role: captain of the warship GVTS: you read the whole picture the fleet sees on the dradis and give the crew their orders by radio; you press no keys. Your orders stay in force on the crew's order board until you replace them
mission: bring the ship to missile range of the nearest enemy ship and have weapons engage it; hold the ship still while no enemy is in sight; send the ship to dock for repairs, retreat, patrol or save energy when the fight calls for it

close_to.say: close to {range} km of {name}, now {distance} km at bearing {bearing}
close_to.when: orders helms to fly to missile range of the nearest enemy ship, giving its range and world bearing as the dradis shows them. Choose this when that enemy is farther than missile range or closer than a missile arms

engage.when: orders weapons to lock the nearest enemy ship and launch missiles at it. Choose this when that enemy is inside missile range

hold_fire.when: orders weapons to stop firing guns and missiles; cancels an engage order. Choose this to stop the ship shooting

hold_here.when: orders helms to stop the ship where it is. Choose this when the dradis shows no enemy ship

chase_target.when: orders helms to run the nearest enemy ship down at full speed and weapons to lock it. Choose this when that enemy is running

preserve_energy.when: orders every seat that spends energy to save it: no afterburner, guns only at close range, thrusters, radars and tubes at low power, scans only while a ship is unidentified. Choose this when the energy store runs low

dock_for_repair.say: dock at {name} for armor repairs, {distance} km at bearing {bearing}
dock_for_repair.when: orders helms to fly to the nearest allied station and dock, and the engineer to run the docked repairs; the order is done once docked, and the ship stays docked until you order it off. Choose this when the armor is badly damaged or the magazine runs low and a station is near

undock.when: orders helms to undock. Choose this once the ship is repaired and restocked

dock_below_armor.say: dock at {name} once armor falls below half
dock_below_armor.when: a standing order: once half the armor plates are gone, helms docks at that station for repairs. Choose this at the start of a fight with a station near

retreat.when: orders helms to run 10 km away from the nearest enemy ship. Choose this when the ship is losing the fight

hold_position.when: orders helms to keep the ship still whatever the enemy does, until you push on. Choose this to wait for the enemy to come

patrol.when: orders helms to sweep up and down behind the nearest nebula, hidden from the nearest enemy. Choose this to wait unseen

push_on.when: revokes the docking, retreat, patrol or hold order: the ship fights under your maneuver orders again

defensive.when: sets the stance: repairs and navigation before the fight, no afterburner, the gun only inside 4 km. Choose this when the ship is badly hurt

offensive.when: sets the stance: the fight before navigation and repairs, the engineer gives the guns full power. Choose this when the enemy is weaker

all_out.when: sets the stance: everything into the fight, guns, tubes and thrusters at full power, afterburner onto the enemy; cancels an order to preserve energy. Choose this to finish a crippled enemy

chase.when: sets the stance: maneuvers before everything, afterburner onto the enemy. Choose this when the enemy runs

take_opportunities.when: sets the stance: weapons switches its lock to any enemy much nearer than its target. Choose this with several enemies about

preserve_ammo.when: sets the stance: guns and missiles only inside 3 km. Choose this when the magazine runs low
